name: Gyeyak×Yeonae
source:
On a spring day beneath falling cherry blossoms, your confession is publicly rejected. But she then proposes something unexpected: three months of contract dating. What was meant to be fake becomes complicated when a devoted junior's hidden feelings emerge. Can this arranged love become real? 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4064700/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在樱花飘落的春日，你的告白遭到公开拒绝。但她随后提出了一些意想不到的建议：三个月的合同约会。当忠诚的后辈隐藏的感情浮现出来时，本来应该是假的事情就变得复杂了。这段安排好的爱情能否成为现实呢？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4064700/]Steam[/url]]
